description: Structured eval definitions for the Elastic Beanstalk Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Beanstalk scenarios (web server with immutable deployment, worker tier with SQS, blue-green CNAME swap, .ebextensions with RDS, missing service role prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Web server Node.js environment with ALB and immutable deployment
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AL2023 Node.js, ALB, immutable policy, enhanced health, managed updates, VPC subnets, ASG
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Elastic Beanstalk environment named myapp-prod for application myapp in us-east-1. Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Node.js 20. Application version v2 from s3://myapp-deploy/app-v2.zip. Load balancer: ALB. Deployment policy: immutable. Enhanced health reporting: enabled. Managed updates: enabled, minor level, Mon:02:00 window. VPC vpc-aaa11122 with subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb. Security group sg-app-prod. ASG: min=2, max=8, CPUUtilization 20-80%. Tags: Environment=production, App=myapp.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ELASTIC_BEANSTALK: myapp / myapp-prod
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment: myapp-prod (WebServer tier)
  [✓] Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Node.js 20
  [✓] Deployment policy: Immutable
  [✓] Enhanced health: enabled
  [✓] Managed updates: enabled (Mon:02:00, minor)
  [✓] Load balancer: ALB
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws elasticbeanstalk describe-environments --environment-names myapp-prod

eval_cases.name: Worker tier Python environment with SQS queue integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Worker tier, SQS daemon, queue-depth auto scaling, no ELB
eval_cases.prompt: Create a worker tier Elastic Beanstalk environment named myapp-worker for application myapp in us-east-1. Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Python 3.11. Application version v1 from s3://myapp-deploy/app-worker-v1.zip. SQS queue: arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:myapp-jobs. Auto scaling on queue depth: lower=1, upper=10. ASG: min=1, max=4.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ELASTIC_BEANSTALK: myapp / myapp-worker
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Environment: myapp-worker (Worker tier)
  [✓] Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Python 3.11
  [✓] SQS queue: arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:myapp-jobs
  [✓] Auto scaling: queue depth (lower=1, upper=10)

eval_cases.name: Blue-green deployment using CNAME swap
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — green environment deployed, CNAME swap procedure, rollback path
eval_cases.prompt: Set up a blue-green deployment for Elastic Beanstalk application myapp in us-east-1. Blue environment myapp-blue is currently serving traffic (environment-id e-blue123). Deploy green environment myapp-green with version v2 using the same configuration template myapp-prod-template. Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Node.js 20. ALB, immutable deployment policy, enhanced health enabled. Once green is Ready and Green health, swap CNAMEs.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ELASTIC_BEANSTALK: myapp / myapp-green
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Green environment: myapp-green (Ready, Green health)
  [✓] CNAME swap: swap-environment-cnames
  [✓] Rollback path: swap CNAMEs back if needed

eval_cases.name: Environment with .ebextensions for IaC including RDS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — .ebextensions with options, RDS (Retain), hooks, rolling+additional batch
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Elastic Beanstalk environment named myapp-api for application myapp in us-east-1. Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Node.js 20. The source bundle includes .ebextensions/01-options.config (NODE_ENV=production), .ebextensions/02-rds.config (PostgreSQL db.t3.micro, DeletionPolicy Retain), and .ebextensions/03-hooks.config (npm run migrate, leader_only). Deployment policy: rolling with additional batch. ALB, enhanced health. ASG: min=2, max=6. VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ELASTIC_BEANSTALK: myapp / myapp-api
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] .ebextensions: 01-options.config, 02-rds.config, 03-hooks.config
  [✓] RDS: PostgreSQL db.t3.micro (DeletionPolicy: Retain)
  [✓] Deployment policy: Rolling + additional batch

eval_cases.name: Environment without service role (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — service role aws-elasticbeanstalk-service-role does not exist
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Elastic Beanstalk environment named myapp-prod for application myapp in us-east-1. Platform: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.0.4 running Node.js 20. Application version v2 from s3://myapp-deploy/app-v2.zip. The service role aws-elasticbeanstalk-service-role does not exist yet. VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa, subnet-bbb.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ELASTIC_BEANSTALK: myapp / myapp-prod
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Service role: aws-elasticbeanstalk-service-role — MISSING; environment creation will fail without it
